name: Torens, Fist of the Angels
clause: Training / create a 1/1 green and white Human Soldier creature token with training.

needs.proposedSignature: KeywordRegistry: { training: true } (so it is legal in CardDef.keywords, token.keywords and grant-keyword) + KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS.training = 'whenever ~ attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on ~'; the behaviour needs an attacks trigger with a new condition { kind: 'attacking-with-greater-power' }
needs.semantics: Whenever this creature attacks together with at least one other attacking creature whose power is greater than this creature's, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Also has to be expressible as a keyword ON A TOKEN, which is what Torens' second line creates.
